literalGroups.primaryGround: OpenStax A&P 2e states that the human heart has four chambers, with one atrium and one ventricle on each side (Heart Anatomy L60). The proposed alternatives are the same category of neighboring chamber counts; fish and amphibian examples make two and three plausible comparison values (Biology 2e 40.1 L53, L56). Four is the only supported human-heart count.
literalGroups.locator: OpenStax A&P 2e Heart Anatomy L60; OpenStax Biology 2e 40.1 L53, L56

literalGroups.literal: Сердце человека имеет четыре камеры: два предсердия и два желудочка. Правая половина направляет кровь к лёгким, а левая — в большой круг кровообращения.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The first sentence directly states the four human chambers. The source says each side has an atrium and ventricle (Heart Anatomy L60); the second sentence is supported by its description of ventricles pumping to lungs or the rest of the body (L60-L64).

literalGroups.literal: У рыб сердце имеет две камеры: предсердие и желудочек.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note says fish have one atrium and one ventricle, matching the source description of their two-chambered heart and the roles of those chambers.

literalGroups.literal: Межпредсердная перегородка разделяет предсердия, а межжелудочковая — желудочки.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The note names the interatrial septum between atria and interventricular septum between ventricles, both stated in the anatomy passage.

literalGroups.literal: Сердце большинства земноводных имеет три камеры: два предсердия и один желудочек.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The source states that amphibians have two atria and one ventricle, and describes the resulting three-chambered heart.

literalGroups.literal: Клапаны расположены в отверстиях между камерами и на выходах к лёгочному стволу и аорте; они направляют кровь в одну сторону.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The source places valves in openings between atria and ventricles and at the exits to the pulmonary trunk and aorta, and states that valves ensure one-way blood flow.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: У рыб сердце имеет две камеры: предсердие и желудочек.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The answer is a standalone short numeral response to “Сколько камер”; all four alternatives use the same grammatical form and category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Fish have a two-chambered heart with one atrium and one ventricle, so “two” is a credible same-category count but not the human count; the note is true and gives a useful animal comparison.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Межпредсердная перегородка разделяет предсердия, а межжелудочковая — желудочки.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The answer is a standalone short numeral response to “Сколько камер”; all four alternatives use the same grammatical form and category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: The source explicitly gives four as the human count, making this the unique key. The note adds how septa separate each pair of chambers, an accurate useful fact beyond the prompt and key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.locator: OpenStax A&P 2e Heart Anatomy L60, L106-L108

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Сердце большинства земноводных имеет три камеры: два предсердия и один желудочек.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The answer is a standalone short numeral response to “Сколько камер”; all four alternatives use the same grammatical form and category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Three is a nearby count and is the documented chamber count for most amphibians, so it is a plausible distractor without being correct for humans. The note states the amphibian arrangement accurately.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.note: Клапаны расположены в отверстиях между камерами и на выходах к лёгочному стволу и аорте; они направляют кровь в одну сторону.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.grammar: The answer is a standalone short numeral response to “Сколько камер”; all four alternatives use the same grammatical form and category.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteAssessments.plausibilityUniqueKeyAndNoteTruthUsefuln: Five is a neighboring numerical alternative. The note teaches that valves occupy openings between chambers and vessel exits; counting those structures as additional chambers would confuse two different anatomical structures.

correctNoteNewFact.newFact: The interatrial septum separates the two atria and the interventricular septum separates the two ventricles; this is additional to the question’s count and key.

absoluteDifficulty.ground: The four-chamber count is a basic, widely taught human-anatomy fact. The prompt asks for a familiar small integer only; it uses no specialist terminology or multistep reasoning. The four alternatives are neighboring values in one category, with actual fish and amphibian counts supporting two and three as plausible comparisons.
